content.text: {"answer":"None of the provided papers mention “Hoehndorf” or a “Hoehndorf drug safety knowledge graph,” so the results do not answer your specific query directly. [1] instead presents SIDEKICK, a drug safety knowledge graph built from FDA Structured Product Labels, standardizing drug indications, contraindications, and adverse reactions, and mapping terms to HPO, MONDO, and RxNorm as an RDF graph for safety surveillance and phenotype-based similarity. [9] provides CTG-DB, a pipeline transforming ClinicalTrials.gov into a database aligned to standardized adverse event terminology (using MedDRA) for cross-trial drug safety analyses, but it is not described as a drug safety knowledge graph.\n\nIf you meant a different “drug safety knowledge graph,” the closest match is SIDEKICK’s semantics-integrated KG approach. If you meant a specific Hoehndorf resource, it is not present in the supplied papers.","grounded":false}
